title.zh-Hant: NASA Global Hawk 颶風任務

subtitle.zh-Hant: 2012 年 9 月 6–7 日・NASA 實測導航紀錄

note.zh-Hant: HS3 任務的機上導航紀錄：從加州 Dryden 飛往維吉尼亞州 Wallops，途中繞過 Leslie 颶風東側。大多每分鐘取一筆，接近降落時每 15 秒一筆；高度是 WGS84 橢球高。紀錄有 12 分鐘和 4 分鐘兩段空白，以直線連接。
note.en: Onboard navigation data from the HS3 mission: from Dryden, California to Wallops, Virginia, passing the east side of Hurricane Leslie. Mostly one row a minute, every 15 s near landing; altitude is above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Gaps of 12 and 4 minutes in the record are joined by straight lines.

citation: Sorenson, C. (2025). Hurricane and Severe Storm Sentinel (HS3) Global Hawk Navigation [Data set]. NASA Global Hydrometeorology Resource Center Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/HS3/NAV/DATA201

events.zh-Hant: 紀錄中斷 12 分鐘（以直線連接）
紀錄恢復，往南繞向 Leslie 颶風東側
events.en: Record resumes, heading around the east side of Hurricane Leslie

events.zh-Hant: 紀錄中斷 4 分鐘（以直線連接）
